title.value: Research Note on Uncertain Probabilities and Abstract Argumentation
title.justification: The title is clearly stated at the beginning of the paper, indicating the main focus of the research.
title.quote: Research Note on Uncertain Probabilities and Abstract Argumentation

extractions.description: This paper discusses the formal account of uncertain probabilities in abstract argumentation settings, with a focus on probabilistic inference using distribution semantics. It explores the application of beta distributions to represent epistemic and aleatory uncertainty in argumentation frameworks and compares different approaches for probabilistic evaluations.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper is about probabilistic inference and abstract argumentation rather than directly addressing climate or ecologically-related sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: In this paper, we propose a formal account for allowing such degrees of belief and the associated confidence to be used to label arguments in abstract argumentation settings.

primary_category.quote: The ultimate goal of this research is to support human decision makers in their tasks of reasoning in presence of aleatory and epistemic uncertainty.
